review:
Mighty Masks takes you to the savannah with 20 paylines and animal masks. Mystery Mask symbols reveal either a paying symbol or a wild, and if masks land on three or more reels, they spread down to the bottom of their reels before revealing.

The Nudge Wild activates a multiplier wheel at the side that adds a global multiplier to the total win for that spin, and the wheel can nudge up to 50 times, increasing the multiplier with every nudge. Three or more FS symbols start the Serengeti Sunset bonus with enhanced features. Hacksaw gives it a 4 out of 5 volatility score and a 10,000x maximum. The top RTP is 96.3%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
